## Structure and components

- [statement] Key vectors in transformer self-attention contain sensitive channel-specific magnitude spikes that cause severe perplexity degradation if quantized uniformly with standard symmetric rounding. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-examples/tree/main/llms · keywords: Asymmetric KV Cache Quantization Algorithms · also: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Asymmetric KV cache quantization preserves key vector outlier dimensions in FP8 or FP16 while quantizing value vectors to 4-bit affine blocks, reducing KV memory by up to 70% with less than 0.1 perplexity delta. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-examples/tree/main/llms · keywords: Asymmetric KV Cache Quantization Algorithms · also: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm
